summary: B03 delivered: synthetic pointer, scroll, and key commands route through GPUI's native pipeline and input.rs is diagnostic-free. B04 delivered the focus primitive dispatch_focus -> Window::focus(&FocusHandle) with no synthetic key event, and the unreachable named-node to FocusHandle resolution is cited with exact gpui-pre line references and referred to Batch C alongside C04 text replacement.

tests.command: cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests — scoped: zero diagnostics in crates/gpui-mcp/src/input.rs; the only remaining errors are the two known Batch B integration points service.rs:601 and lib.rs:71, both B05-owned

cargo test -p gpui-mcp --lib input::tests (scratch copy of this worktree with service.rs:601 and lib.rs:71 locally patched only so the crate links; the shared crate cannot link until B05 lands) — 6 passed, 0 failed

B03-SYNTHETIC-INPUT-ROUTING.evidence: Pointer commands build the same MouseMove/MouseDown/MouseUp/ScrollWheel PlatformInput variants as before and dispatch them with Window::dispatch_event (input.rs:109); keystrokes use Window::dispatch_keystroke, which builds PlatformInput::KeyDown and calls Window::dispatch_event internally (gpui-pre window.rs:5373-5382) and then feeds key_char to the active input handler, so key bindings and text entry keep the native path. Evidence: cargo check -p gpui-mcp --tests reports zero diagnostics in input.rs, and in the scratch run synthetic_mouse_move_runs_gpui_hover_handlers (move), synthetic_platform_drag_runs_gpui_drag_and_drop_handlers (click/down/move/up), synthetic_scroll_wheel_runs_gpui_scroll_handlers, and synthetic_keystroke_runs_focused_element_key_handlers all pass.

B04-FOCUS-NAVIGATION.evidence: dispatch_focus(handle, window, cx) routes through Window::focus(&FocusHandle) (gpui-pre window.rs:2302) with no synthetic key event; dispatch_focus_moves_focus_without_a_key_event passes. Named-node to FocusHandle resolution is unreachable from outside the crate and is cited and referred to Batch C (joining C04 text replacement): A11y is pub(crate) (window/a11y.rs:126), focus_ids is pub(crate) (window/a11y.rs:149), FocusHandle::for_id is pub(crate) (window.rs:558), App::focus_handles is pub(crate) (window.rs:760), and the only native accesskit::NodeId-to-focus path is handle_a11y_action, also pub(crate) (window.rs:6805; Action::Focus branch 6847-6853). A Batch C visibility item (for example a public Window::focus_a11y_node(accesskit::NodeId, cx) -> bool wrapping that branch, with the observer retaining each node's accesskit_id from debug_a11y_tree_json) plus bridge-side resolution in observer.rs/service.rs closes the referral.

risks: Text entry is temporarily narrowed until C04: InputCommand::TypeText and ReplaceText return ErrorCode::Unsupported because Window::input_handlers is pub(crate) (window.rs:989); the MCP type_text/set_text tools report that error until Batch C lands.
The Batch B gate cargo check --workspace exits 101 from this branch on B05-owned service.rs:601 and lib.rs:71; input.rs itself is clean under the scoped check.

Runtime test evidence came from a scratch copy at C:/Users/ADMINI~1/AppData/Local/Temp/kilo/w2-verify with service.rs/lib.rs patched only to link; the scratch copy was removed and is not part of the deliverable.

In that scratch run two observer.rs tests (observes_roles_labels_and_parentage, repeated_element_ids_stay_frame_unique_and_grouped_by_parent) fail because debug_a11y_tree_json() returns None on a fresh window until C02 activates the a11y tree; external to this task's file but material to B02/B06 integration.

Alternative focus route if the owner prefers no focus-map patch: once C03 exposes node bounds, the already-rewired pointer path can move focus to a named node by clicking its center (the protocol documents NodeAction::Focus as a center click), though that route does not go through Window::focus(&FocusHandle).
